subject: Pricing follow-up & budget owner confirmation - Finex Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ross <emma.ross@finex.ai>, Kai Li <kai.li@finex.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up & budget owner confirmation - Finex Analytics

Hi Emma / Kai —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move to a formal quote and procurement: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary workload: document ingestion + customer support summarization + short-form generation for notifications
- Expected steady-state: ~25M tokens / month, with short-term peaks up to ~40M tokens / month
- Desired unit economics: target $/1M tokens in the ~$250–$350 range (you mentioned ~$300 as a target on the call)

What we need from you to finalize pricing and timelines
1) Confirm the exact budget owner / economic buyer for procurement (name, role, best email) — we want to route the finalized quote and PO request directly.
2) Confirm if finance requires an internal PO or a signed SOW/MSA before committing (and estimated procurement lead time).
3) Any minimum term you prefer? We proposed a 12-month committed tier in the call as one option.

Attached: pricing_sheet_v3.pdf (draft per-token tiers) and mutual_action_plan.xlsx — I've put the rough numbers we discussed into the MAP.

Proposed next steps
- We'll prepare a formal quote with a few tiered options (monthly committed baseline + burst capacity) once you confirm the budget owner and procurement cadence.
- If helpful, I can loop in our Finance Ops lead (Ben) to accelerate PO/contract questions and Dev for any security/procurement artifacts.

Would you be able to confirm the budget owner and expected procurement timeline by end of week? Thanks — that will let us get a signed quote to you early next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: pricing_sheet_v3.pdf (1 page, draft tiers)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emma Ross <emma.ross@finex.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Li <kai.li@finex.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & budget owner confirmation - Finex Analytics

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary and for the attachments. Quick answers below: 

Token volumes and target economics
- Confirming our internal projection: steady-state ~25M tokens/month; expected peak up to ~40M/month for campaign periods.
- Our target $/1M tokens is around $300, with some flexibility depending on committed volume and term.

Budget / procurement
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Kai Li (Head of Finance) — kai.li@finex.ai (cc'd). He's the approver for vendor spend > $5k/month.
- Finance process: we typically need a formal quote and an MSA/SOW for legal review. The team will raise a PO once legal signs off. Typical procurement lead time is 1–3 weeks after we receive final contract/quote.

Budget range
- For Q2 planning, the rough budget range we're evaluating is $7,500–$12,000/month (aligned with the numbers we discussed; 25M tokens @ $300/1M = $7,500/month).

Next steps
- Please send a formal quote and an MSA/SOW (redlines welcome). If you can include a committed 12-month option and a month-to-month option with burst pricing, that'd be ideal.
- We'll prioritize review and get back with a PO timeline once Kai confirms.

I'm attaching an internal note from our finance team that outlines PO routing (finex_budget_note.pdf) for reference.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Ross
Head of Product, Integrations | Finex Analytics
emma.ross@finex.ai | +1 (212) 555-0148

--
Attachment: finex_budget_note.pdf (internal finance routing note)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up & budget owner confirmation - Finex Analytics

Great, thanks Emma (+ Kai). Appreciate the clarity on budget range and process.

We'll proceed as follows: 
- I'll send a formal quote with two options:
  1) Committed 12-month: baseline 25M tokens/month at $280 per 1M tokens (discounted rate; includes 20% burst capacity at same unit rate).
  2) Month-to-month: baseline pricing at $320 per 1M tokens with per-token burst pricing for peaks.
- I will attach a redline-friendly MSA and a short SOW.
- Ben (cc'd) from Finance Ops will join the loop for PO/billing details. Dev, if we can get the standard security artifacts (SOC2, network diagram) into the Google Drive link, that will speed legal review — I can surface those in a single package.

Can you confirm that Kai will be the approver for the PO (so I can address the quote to him) and whether your legal team prefers DocuSign or upload to your vendor portal for signatures?

If you confirm today, I'll aim to get the quote + MSA over by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks — Marissa
